title: 3dtk: the 3D'omics ToolKit
description: A Python package and command-line tool to find, summarise, export, and download records from the 3D'omics data catalogue. Provides a uniform query/values/stats/fields/fetch grammar across the experiment, specimen, macrosample, cryosection, microsample, genome and count levels; dense reconstruction of the sparse genome-by-sample count matrices; spatially resolved microsample metadata; and checksum-verified downloads resolved through the ENA Portal API.
